title: Simulated Gamma-Ray Burst Event Dataset A1
purpose: A1 dataset is specifically created to build a large sample of simulated gamma-ray bursts generated with gtobssim. Its primary purpose is to provide a controlled and statistically significant set of GRB events for training Generative AI models and developing anomaly detection methods.

provenance.sources: Monte Carlo simulations of gamma-ray burst events using standard astrophysical simulation frameworks.
provenance.processing: Events were generated through Monte Carlo simulations, then filtered based on quality criteria including reconstruction quality, angular separation, and energy thresholds. The filtering process removed low-quality events and retained high-confidence detections suitable for scientific analysis.
provenance.derivations: Derived quantities include the Monte Carlo source identifier (MC_SRC_ID) and the true photon energy from the Monte Carlo simulation (MCENERGY). The containment angle (CONT_ANG) and the event weight (WEIGHT) are instead computed from the instrument Point Spread Function (PSF), characterizing the angular reconstruction performance.

quality.validation: Events underwent automated quality filtering based on reconstruction parameters. Data integrity verified through HDF5 file validation and statistical checks on key parameters.
limitations: Event statistics vary significantly between simulations due to different source parameters and observing conditions
Coordinate precision limited by reconstruction algorithms used in simulation
No instrumental background events are included in this filtered dataset
quality.usageGuidance: This dataset is recommended for algorithm development, pipeline testing, and machine learning training.

access.reuseGuidance: Users must cite this dataset when using it in publications or derivative works. Commercial use is permitted. Modified versions should clearly indicate changes from the original dataset.
